quests.title: The Owl's Round Door
quests.settle: Glim the owl is a little ruffled. Breathe with her slowly.

explore.intro: Tap things to make them bloom. Somewhere is a hidden gem.

gem.name: a tiny hat on a rock

easy.q: I have hands but I can't clap. I tell you when it's time for a nap.
What gets wetter the more it dries?
easy.hint: You use me after a bath.

easy.q: I'm full of holes, but I still hold water.
I have keys, but I can't open any door.

medium.q: The more you take, the more you leave behind.
medium.hint: Look down at the path behind you.

medium.q: I run but never walk. I have a mouth but never talk. I have a bed but never sleep.
I'm light as a feather, but even the strongest person can't hold me for long.
medium.hint: You just practised me with Glim.

hard.q: I have cities but no houses, forests but no trees, and water but no fish.
hard.hint: Explorers fold me up and put me in a pocket.

quests.title: The Lantern Gate
quests.settle: Teaspoon is curled up tight. Breathe slowly so she can uncurl.

explore.intro: Tap things to make them bloom. One of them is hiding a gem.

door.intro: The gate opens when its lanterns glow in the order of the stars above them.
door.hint: Count the little stars over each lantern. Start with the one that has one star.

quests.title: The Stone Bridge
quests.subject: math
quests.settle: Clover is worried about the bridge. Breathe with him.

explore.intro: Tap things to make them bloom. Look for a hidden gem.

door.hint: Count the empty spaces on the bridge.
